description: A vote cast on a community governance proposal. Lives in the voter's own repo and is signed with the voter's key, and carries the community-signed member and role records that entitled the voter at the moment it was cast, so a third party can recheck both the vote and the electorate against signed records. This is tamper-evidence and public consistency rather than independence from the PDS, which holds the signing keys of the accounts it hosts; independence is complete only for externally-hosted voters.

community.description: DID of the community the proposal belongs to.

proposal.description: Strong reference (uri + cid) to the proposal record as it stood when the vote was cast.

proposalRkey.description: Record key of the proposal record in the community repo.

castBy.description: DID of the actor who actually cast the vote. Present only for delegated votes, where it is the delegate's DID; absent for direct votes.

delegation.description: Strong reference to the net.openfederation.community.delegation record that authorised a delegated vote. Present only for delegated votes.

eligibility.description: Membership evidence captured when the vote was cast (#200).

Membership evidence as it stood when the vote was cast: the community-signed member and role records consulted, and the permission they resolved to. Lets a third party recheck the electorate instead of trusting the tally.

member.description: The voter's member record in the community repo.

roleRecord.description: The role record naming the permission set. Absent when the member record names no roleRkey and permissions come from the built-in table.

roleName.description: Role in force at cast time.

unresolved.description: Set when the evidence could not be assembled, naming why.
